Jin-Hyuk, blessed with the ability to sense non-human beings thanks to his shaman father, is astonished when Doey, a playful and curious fairy, falls in love with him and begins to visit his dreams. What starts as innocent and harmless fun quickly evolves into intimate encounters, blurring the boundaries between dreams and reality. As their bond deepens, Jin-Hyuk's initial uncertainty turns into an insatiable longing for Doey's enchanting presence. Together, they embark on a whimsical romantic journey, navigating the complexities of love in a dreamscape as fresh as milk and as sweet as cream.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Haruto, a shy, spoiled boy who loves BL, joined the manga research club that he had dreamed about when he entered university! The beginning of his new life with his new otaku friends…or so he thought. For some reason, his childhood friend, Yosuke, who doesn’t even read manga, ended up joining the club as well. Haruto is tired of being teased by Yosuke all the time, but for some reason Yosuke seems to be just like his favorite BL character…?? Is it normal for an otaku to get excited about this even if they don’t like it?!

Now here comes Seo Eunsung, one of the greatest guides alive, and he’s determined to guide Taegun whether he likes it or not. So: irresistible force meets immovable object. She must fall in love with the cat butler of her destiny who truly loves and cares for cats, and kiss. On top of that, a mysterious yet familiar cat murderer starts chasing Sara’s catself after she witnesses the murderer killing a cat with a stone. Will Sara be able to protect herself from the cat murderer? Will she be able to break the spell with a kiss from the butler of her destiny?

Garin, an ordinary high-school girl, is given magical powers that can help fight all kinds of “villains” around her. The catch? The magic transformation is nothing short of mortifying to the teenager. But do not judge a book by its cover! College student Haiga, now a senior, has finally moved in with his boyfriend, Kanae, a former classmate and brothel beauty who’s since graduated and joined the workforce. And although they’re living together, that doesn’t mean they aren’t both still busy with their own lives—Kanae with work and Haiga with his career aspirations.

Noticing Haiga’s job search hasn’t been going well—and that they haven’t been on a date in a while—Kanae decides to take him out to cheer him up. Unfortunately, even that doesn’t go well, and Kanae falls ill. But as the seasons pass, the two affirm and reaffirm their relationship, and before long, it’s time for Haiga’s final college performance—his graduation concert!

After a failed marriage, Tae-Hwa Han, an omega, has a one-night stand with his brother-in-law, Yi Shin Yoon, an alpha and famous actor, resulting in a child—Si-Woo. Four years later, Yi Shin reappears in Tae-Hwa’s life, unaware that he has a son. Tae-Hwa keeps this secret, grappling with old feelings and the painful truth of their relationship. As they reconnect, Tae-Hwa must decide if they can rekindle their relationship—and whether Yi Shin will accept the son he never knew he had.

A decade later, he awakens in a new body, devoid of his former powers. With the support of his new comrades, Spirit Master Balkan and hobgoblin Haryu, he embarks on a quest for vengeance, scaling the mysterious tower once again. Only this time, he possesses the overpowered abilities of an "All-Master," enabling him to master all the occupations within the tower!

Mistaken as a rumored super-rookie, our hero reluctantly picks up the ball. But, this time, it looks like there is something to help him carry on.

Through a negotiation, he got inside Castle and started working with the enemy... Will Shin be able to take down Castle and complete his revenge as he hoped?

166652.description:
Hwa-Won knows better than to pick things off the street, even if it is just an innocent-looking USB. In an effort to find the owner, Hwa-Won discovers that the USB belongs to her favorite GL writer, Kim Yuri, and has unreleased chapters of the latter’s new sequel! As a zealous fan, Hwa-won can hardly resist herself from devouring the chapters in one setting. However, she seems to have forgotten that curiosity is not just hazardous to cats! Because the USB doesn’t just contain the chapters to the sequel. It also contains things that leave Hwa-Won upset. Now Hwa-Won needs answers and Kim Yuri’s the only one who has them. But Kim Yuri is a staunch recluse who refuses to leave her house! How is Hwa-Won to meet her?! Soon, online meets offline, fiction meets reality and as the pages turn, it is no longer Hwa-Won doing the chasing!

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

A story about a professor and his assistant, working hard on their research every day. While clumsily hiding pursuit of their mutual affection for each other, they go back and forth on growing close and drifting apart, creating a perfect sense of distance in this strange laboratory romantic comedy!

Se-Jun, your average Seoul underdog, didn’t expect to grow tomatoes full-time when he stumbled into the mysterious dungeon full of monster quests and extravagant rewards. Yet, there he was, as a farmer growing and selling cash crops while clearing numerous quests that came his way. Will Se-Jun make it out of the dungeon with the plush rewards he hoped for? At least he has what it takes: optimism, resourcefulness, and a group of loyal furry friends.

However, Liesel got a second chance as she suddenly woke up as her childhood self. She took this as a chance to change her fate, and tried to live without forming any attachments to the crown prince or the saintess. But by a strange twist of fate, she became entangled with the saintess's childhood friend! A woman with a strong will to survive, ensnared by fateーLiesel's success story begins here!

Reborn as the third prince of a tiny and insignificant country, Hero happens to learn the forbidden-yet-powerful art of alchemy. Combined with his knowledge from modern-day Japan, Hero's abilities grow beyond what anyone in his world could fathom! With his newly-acquired powers, he’ll bring his country back from the verge of extinction...! A combination of modern-day knowledge and alchemy to turn a weak little country into a prosperous nation!

A forest spirit split Miyako's personality into independent beings. Now she and her three alter egos decide to run a handyman business to make a living, but...!?

A man against love, and a woman in need for money... Is this love real or fake?!

(Source: Toomics)

166672.description:
Kentarou is a gruff and stoic dogman who can’t help but wag his tail whenever he sees his boyfriend, Inukai. Despite his stern exterior, he’s an affectionate and doting boyfriend. Along with coworker Nekomiya and his feline boyfriend Shimada, Kentarou and Inukai enjoy days filled with sappy partners and heaps of affection!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for commercial publication in a collected volume on 2022-09-28.

166673.description:
Haewon Shin, 20 years old, finally escapes from his three nagging sisters when he gets into a college in Seoul. With his dream to hook up with an attractive guy at a club, he rents a small studio apartment and begins to look for the right guy--and he succeeds. Not only that, he even has the most wonderful one-night stand with him! However, when the guy hears that Haewon majors in culinary art, he makes a suspicious run out of the room.

Meanwhile, the studio that seemed so perfect turns out to have a loud neighbor upstairs. Unable to take the noise any longer, Haewon heads upstairs to confront the matter, only to find that upstairs is not an apartment but a bustling restaurant popular on social media. To Haewon's surprise, he encounters his dreamy one-night stand working there as a chef! But what could be the reason he's giving Haewon the cold shoulder...?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

166674.description:
Yeong-Hyeon is a quiet and nice boy who is leaving school early when he runs into Dae-Han, an intimidating classmate rumored to have ties to a gang. Although Yeong-Hyeon tries to sneak past him, Dae-Han drags him to a cafe and asks him to be his boyfriend when they're both guys and have never even spoken before! Undeterred by Yeong-Hyeon's immediate refusal, Dae-Han walks him to school, buys him snacks, and changes seats to sit beside him. Eventually, his constant attention begins to grow on Yeong-Hyeon...

They say opposites attract, but can these two very different boys find love together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

166675.description:
Ken is a comic artist who works shut up in his room. His manga don't sell at all, but he has put all his faith into his childhood friend and editor, Yuuma. Though Yuuma holds Ken's utmost trust in his hands, he also has a secret...Ken and Yuuma desire every last bit of each other. A love story that is both pure and utterly dark.

(Source: NTT Solmare)

- Original serialization ran for five chapters. In the volume release, Chapters 2 and 3 were combined as Chapter 2.

166676.description:
In the scorching heat of summer, Seokhyun's life takes an unexpected turn as he and his family leave the bustling city behind and settle into a serene countryside town. Seokhyun quickly attracts attention and gains popularity among his new classmates. However, Seokhyun's gaze is irresistibly drawn to Heebok, his quiet classmate with striking blond hair. As Heebok helps Seokhyun discover the simple joys of country living, tender moments are shared between them, and love quietly blooms beneath the warm, sun-kissed skies.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters (rated R-19).

Jaehee’s always prided himself on being a reasonable alpha. All that pheromone nonsense between alphas and omegas? Ruts? Heats? He thinks it primitive, and considers his two-year long relationship with the beta Yeowoon as true, pure love. But all that comes to a screeching halt when he finds himself stuck on a bus with an older omega going through heat. After one night of passion(and infidelity) with the said omega, Jaehee finds himself tormented. He’d always thought himself as a nice guy above all that alpha stuff, so what is he to do now? Jaehee knew that night would be the ruin of him but he didn’t know just how much, until he comes across the same omega on campus…

(Source: Lezhin US)

After an untimely death, a Shinto exorcist finds herself reincarnated into another world as Miss Nicola von Weber. And that’s just the start of her troubles. On Nicola’s first day at a new school, she’s reunited with her childhood friend Sieghart. He’s now a handsome marquess who acts like a spoiled child around her, and wherever he goes, strange incidents follow. You see, Sieghart’s beauty attracts both people and...otherworldly admirers. Nicola thus has to put her homework aside and use her skills as an exorcist to save him—all while trying to avoid his inevitable proposal, for Sieghart once swore he’d never marry anyone but her. And so Nicola’s hectic, haunted life continues with a splash of romance, which she almost finds more annoying than the ghosts. All Nicola wants is normalcy, and this is the story of how she’ll (try to) get it.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Drawing upon her battle-hardened experience, she forms the mercenary group Moon Blossom and pioneers the concept of the soldier-mage: magic users who also fight with the skills and training of military soldiers. Roaming the battlefields of this new world, Moon Blossom—led by Asura and her unrivaled schemes, ruthlessness, and tactical ingenuity—earns a fearsome reputation. Thus the curtain rises on the dark fantasy epic of a young girl who is spoken of in fearful whispers as “The Silver Demon”!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Yujin is a “normal” teenager who’s preparing to retake his college entrance exams. He is not into boys. Nope. But as time goes on, Yujin can’t deny his increasing attraction to Jun-hyeok and reluctantly admits that he’s probably as straight as a circle. 166964.description:
I am Rinceir the Elf, the greatest foodie in the elven world! In the castle town of Farenheit, there appeared a man who pulled a mysterious cart that served a strange new food called "ramen." Each bite tasted heavenly! I quickly became captivated by this "ramen" and waited for him and his cart to come by every night. However, one night, that man I had come to call my "friend" disappeared from my life. Twenty years later, I am still waiting on the same street corner, hoping to see "ramen" again. Oh...... my beloved "ramen", will I ever be able to taste it again......?

(Source: Pash Books, translated)

166965.description:

But how is he supposed to achieve this feat when the Gods won’t even give him a simple status screen to help on his quest? Plus, what’s only supposed to be a loveless contract marriage seems to be turning into something more the longer Yujin stays with the supposed villain...!

166967.description:
An adaptation of the novel by Jin Yong.

When Chuang Wang seized Peking, the remaining generals of the Ming Dynasty surrendered and gave up their wealth as ransom, piling up a mountain of treasure. When Chuang Wang retreated from the capital, he sent his most trusted lieutenants to hide the treasure somewhere beyond the Great Wall, intending to use it eventually to raise an army for a comeback.

In the 45th year of the Qianlong Emperor (1780), three groups fought a fierce battle somewhere in Changbai Mountains over a treasure chest. The chest not only held clues about the location of Chuang Wang's treasure, it also revealed the past history of Chuang Wang's four lieutenants and the relationship between them. A complex tale that spanned generations.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
